study: Bounded temporal validation of personalized nonprogression in cosmetics recommendation
status: Recorded analysis specification; see evaluation-status qualifications
prior_inspection: October and November feasibility outcomes were inspected. A public December preview was visible during dataset selection; full December eligibility, labels and performance were computed after settings were fixed.
source_timestamp_order: Only strictly later purchases qualify. Features use events strictly earlier than source. Candidate exclusion uses every event at or before source.
pseudo_label: One minus indicator of a same-user same-product purchase strictly after cart and within 24h. Missing purchase is not dislike or verified abandonment.

model_training.selection: Latest eligible training-prefix cart per user, then at most 50000 users by SHA-256 of seed and user ID, without label-based selection. Latest rather than first carts allow prior matured cart features to vary.
model_training.model: sklearn MLPClassifier, hidden layers (32,16), ReLU, Adam, learning_rate_init .001, alpha .0001, batch_size 512, max_iter 8, early_stopping false, single fixed seed 20261024
model_training.scaling: StandardScaler fit on selected training cases only
full_features: log seconds since prior user event capped at 30 days plus missing flag
log prior fully matured user cart successes
log prior fully matured user cart nonprogressions
model_training.context_control: Same network, optimizer, seed, cases and budget, excluding the last two matured cart outcome features

conditional_calibration.selection: Same conditional other-item ranking eligibility, earliest query per user, maximum 10000 users by fixed SHA-256 order
conditional_calibration.method: Positive-slope sigmoid of raw probability logit, fit separately for full and context models on calibration labels only
conditional_calibration.stop_if: Fewer than 200 calibration users or fewer than 10 cases in either pseudo-label class
conditional_calibration.global_risk: Mean pseudo-label in conditional calibration cases; fixed for November and December

held_out.download_gate: Historical study settings preceded full December download. Portable reproduction uses locally supplied archives and must not be described as a fresh independent evaluation.

conditional_ranking_cases: Warm pre-cutoff user, first eligible cart followed within 24h by purchase of a different product observed in the pre-cutoff positive-event catalog but never observed for that user at or before query. Select earliest qualifying purchase, ID breaks target-time ties. One earliest eligible query per user, then fixed SHA-256 cap. This conditions on a future other-item purchase and is not an unconditional deployed-user evaluation.
candidate_sampling: Target plus 999 distinct uniform pre-cutoff catalog products unseen through query. Per-user deterministic seed 20261024; same candidates for every model. Previously unpurchased products are unobserved comparisons, not verified negatives.

graph.history: All pre-cutoff users; binary user-product graph retaining each user's 100 most recently observed distinct products, with ascending product ID breaking timestamp ties. Uncapped pre-cutoff histories still define user/catalog eligibility and query exclusions.
graph.reason_for_cap: Fixed computational bound for a small validation study; differs from the uncapped OLX graph and must be disclosed
graph.external_component: P3LTR degree-recency component using existing fixed OLX component coefficients on the same capped graph; not the full published P3LTR model and not retuned on cosmetics

item_profiles: Count all cart sources with source+24h strictly before graph cutoff, with same-item purchase outcome in 24h. Counts are source events, not distinct people. Duplicate event/user/product/second keys are collapsed.

fusion.signal: log(1+mature same-item successes) minus user risk times log(1+mature same-item nonprogressions)
fusion.normalization: Mean-center each signal row; divide every risk variant by the same candidate-row standard deviation of the fixed-global-risk signal plus 1e-8. This avoids changing signal scale with personalized risk.
fusion.shuffled_control: Fixed seeded permutation of calibrated scores among selected cases within each period; negative control only, not a deployable method
fusion.popularity: Candidate-row z-score of log(1+pre-cutoff positive-event count)
fusion.selection: Separately choose each variant weight by November NDCG@10, then Recall@10, then smallest gamma. Serialize choices before December download. Also report controls at the actual model's selected gamma as an exploratory matched-weight sensitivity.

primary_endpoint: December sampled-candidate NDCG@10 difference: actual_calibrated minus fixed_global, each using its November-selected weight
inference: 5000 paired user bootstrap replicates, seed 20261024, 95% percentile interval for the single primary contrast. Other ranking and prediction contrasts are exploratory pointwise intervals without multiplicity adjustment. No claim about practical utility solely from statistical significance.
secondary_outputs: conditional nonprogression AUC, AP, Brier score and log loss
scope: Single-seed, sampled-candidate cross-domain validation; no architecture search, secondary view-to-cart experiment or full-catalog claim.
integrity: Store immutable input/protocol/code fingerprints; smoke-test strict-time features, candidate eligibility, deterministic ties and exact target ranks before held-out evaluation. Any necessary bug repair must be recorded, not silently tuned to results.
